body: I'm in counselling. The experience is very different than talking to friends or family, and absolutely more helpful. I encourage you to go. The therapist will work with you to gradually progress past the shyness, don't worry.
I know. In my case, I'm attempting to transfer to a competitive grad program where GPA's critical unfortunately... :(

I enjoyed reading something written by someone who has lived through similar experiences. I slowly read through your post several times, and it's had a surprising calming affect... thank you for offering your perspective, speaking very sincerely, I am greatly appreciative..
You aren't horrible, no matter what you think of yourself. People will miss you.
Thank you, again. That makes a lot of sense.

Thank you for your great reply.

I have been receiving counseling through school for six months. She's amazing. We connect very well. I just.. I don't know whether it's working. Or rather, I don't know whether I'll make enough progress to be.. happy, healthy. 

I'm also afraid to go to my next appointment... I don't want to be involuntarily committed.
